أعمال عربية
statement: Inscriptions in the old Musnad script, temples and dams of Saba, mudbrick towns climbing the mountains. This is the world my Arabic works come from.

works.title: Veiled Heritage
works.description: A mysterious veiled woman stands against an aged backdrop of Arabian manuscripts and historic desert settlements. A dark portrait inspired by Saudi Arabia’s traditional heritage and forgotten history.

works.title: Echoes of Ancient Arabia
works.description: A sepia-toned vision of an Arabian woman surrounded by ancient ruins, inscriptions, and historic desert settlements.

works.title: Lady of the Old Courtyard
works.description: A striking portrait of a woman in ornate traditional attire, set against a historic courtyard. Warm sepia tones evoke the elegance and mystery of old Arabian architecture.
